tip: Swedish drops the noun after den plus adjective. Here den blå means the blue one, with no noun needed.
After uppmanade, put the object oss first, then att lämna. Pattern: urge someone att plus the verb.
Det var kaffe hon ville ha is a cleft: front the key word after Det var to stress it, and som before hon is dropped.
Försäkra needs om before the clause: försäkrade mig om att. The om is not optional here.
Velat is the supine of vilja, to want. After har it becomes har velat, have wanted.
The clause Som jag förstod det comes first, so the verb var lands before problemet. Verb stays in second slot.
Svara takes på for the thing answered: svarat på mitt mejl. In Swedish you answer on something.
